frozen_record.author: codex-ai-reviewer-s1

exposure.previous_train_imagery: January, February and March 2 TRAIN Caribe, including January 21 context. No calibration/test imagery.

visual_findings.reason: Un cuerpo alargado aislado en agua, coherente en VV y VH y ausente en el contexto. Dos lóbulos intensos conectados forman una sola firma; el trazo difuso al norte no justifica contar una segunda nave. La caja localiza la respuesta SAR principal, sin afirmar bordes físicos ni dimensiones. Centro y caja fuera de los corredores configurados.

La concentración de retorno cambia respecto al contexto y está adosada al eje del muelle. Puede contener un buque atracado, pero no permite aislar un casco de estructura y lóbulos en VV/VH. No usar como negativo.

Retornos brillantes alargados a lo largo del frente del muelle, mezclados con estructuras y posibles embarcaciones. La distinta distribución frente al contexto no determina presencia ni conteo de naves sin casco resoluble. Excluir interfaz de negativos.
Trazos débiles principalmente VV al este de la península; sin casco corroborado. Fuera de la franja marina segura que se conserva para revisión.

constraints: Patios remain terrestrial negative controls away from unknown waterfront; land is excluded from marine anchorage scope.
STC fondeo is mostly peninsula; only the previously inspected northern water strip is a marine scope.
Preserve outside-corridor vessel only as context, without AOI adjustment or outside training label.
No date changes based on positive support.
Null training scope if residual has no native center pixels or no interior after 5 m erosion.

first_pass_before_proposal_geometry.subsequent_exposure: After freezing raw pass, queried proposal IDs/geometries/counts for this cohort; all zero. Scores not queried.

method: Inspected all nonzero target VV/VH and historical VV/VH at native resolution; verified zero-only panels numerically.
Same fixed log-amplitude-DN display: VV20..1000 and VH10..300, not calibrated dB.
Inspected zone and observable masks and focal waterfront windows before model proposals.
Ambiguous coastal returns remain unknown. Fondeo marine scope excludes land. Patios retain explicit terrestrial control scope away from uncertain waterfront.
Partial slices exclude two native pixels next to internal nodata boundaries. Scopes without a 5 m interior are withdrawn.
No family or dimensions inferred; no date replacement based on positive support.
consolidation_notes: Published observations only; missing zones are not empty.
Reference completeness is limited to the explicit reviewed area and visually discernible objects.
March22 isolated vessel between the two northern corridors has its center and localization outside every configured zone. It remains context only; no outside training label or AOI adjustment.
